Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::queryLoanTerm(itemid: Integer): LoanTerm {
	definition:
		loanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid)
	precondition:
		loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newLoanTerm: LoanTerm in
		newLoanTerm.oclIsNew() and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newLoanTerm) and
		result = newLoanTerm
}
